prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 91.3%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 80.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Grid Layout Desktop Companion Overview Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a visual grid layout showcasing essential desktop controls and pet interaction shortcuts before completing setup. (why: Users submitted support tickets confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after completing onboarding (3 emails).)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic Stage Screen: Add a dedicated diagnostic step during the generation waiting stage that verifies desktop pet display permissions and screen placement. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting that pets do not show on the desktop or the app fails to launch visually after onboarding.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Stage Layout Photo Validation Studio Redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen using a stage layout with step-by-step lighting and framing preview checks before custom pet generation. (why: Custom pet generation fails or results look wrong for multiple users (3 support tickets), and adoption stage has drop-off (69.9%).)
3: [finish, hint] Desktop Shortcut Quick Reference Banner: Add a floating shortcut hint banner at the bottom of the home intro screen detailing quick desktop interaction hotkeys. (why: Users frequently contact support post-onboarding asking how to hide, control, or converse with their desktop pet (3 emails).)
4: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Rendering Stage Time Estimator: Display an explicit live rendering time estimator and progress percentage breakdown on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting screen home step has a high mean time (2336s) and median of 201s, causing user uncertainty about generation progress.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Multi-Pet Account Retention Warning Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to clearly explain that signing in merges existing pet data rather than overwriting desktop companions. (why: The largest support theme (8 emails) concerns lost or reset pets upon sign-in.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Official Adoption Badge Certificate Stamp: Add an animated adoption badge component and celebratory milestone header to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step has substantial drop-off in the middle funnel (69.9% conversion, median 89s).)
7: [choose_path, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interaction Preview Screen: Insert a new interactive preview screen right after the story screen showing pet desktop behaviors before path selection. (why: choose_path stage mean time is 514s; introducing visual context early sets clearer expectations and improves onboarding momentum.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Selection Layout: Transform the choose_path screen layout into a side-by-side two-column view comparing preset vs custom creation paths. (why: Median time on choose_path is fast (8s) but mean is 514s, indicating some users stall while choosing between paths.)
